clue.text: Affordable cuisine, anything but escargots?

definitions.meaning: the straight reading: cheap, quickly served meals such as burgers
snails are the byword for slowness, so food that is anything but snail-like is quick food

explanation.surface: A restaurant critic praising budget cooking as long as it isn't snails.
explanation.walkthrough: Escargots are snails, the proverbially slow creatures; the opposite of snail food is speedy food.
explanation.definitionFit: Burgers and chips sold for quick consumption are cheap eating, the everyday sense of the phrase.

clue.text: Too easy, finding account in dossier

indicators.note: the abbreviation for account sits in the middle of the word for a dossier

parts.note: a dossier is a file of papers on a subject

explanation.surface: An investigator thinks the case was solved too simply once the account turned up in the file.
explanation.definitionFit: Facile describes something achieved with suspicious simplicity, superficially effortless.

clue.text: Mean — as are nettles?

definitions.meaning: first meaning: miserly, tight with money

explanation.walkthrough: The usual sense is miserly; the question mark flags the whimsical reading 'full of stings'.
explanation.definitionFit: A tight-fisted person who hates spending money is called stingy.

clue.text: Confront character in king, say

parts.note: to face someone is to confront them
a card is an eccentric person, a real character

explanation.surface: Standing up to an odd figure in a monarch's role.
explanation.definitionFit: Kings, queens and jacks in a pack are the picture cards, a king being one example.

clue.text: God up in heaven, I'd observed

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the letters are read from bottom to top
in signals that the letters sit inside the run of words that follows

parts.note: the letters run across the end of heaven, all of I'd and the start of observed

explanation.surface: Someone claims to have seen a deity rising up in the sky.
explanation.definitionFit: Odin is the chief deity of Norse mythology, ruler of Asgard.

clue.text: Old boy in schmuck of little worth to Americans

indicators.note: the old boy's letters are placed inside the word for the fool

parts.note: schmuck is slang for a fool, a twit

explanation.surface: A former pupil turns out to be a worthless idiot, in American eyes.
explanation.walkthrough: OB, old boy, is a British former pupil of a school.
explanation.definitionFit: American slang for cheap or trivial, from a quarter dollar being called two bits.

clue.text: Shameless desire, performing

parts.note: to want something is to desire it
an actor who is on is performing on stage

explanation.surface: A brazen craving for the stage.
explanation.definitionFit: Wanton behaviour is immodest and unrestrained, without any sense of shame.

clue.text: Battered book finished off

parts.note: food that is eaten up is finished off entirely

explanation.surface: A well-worn volume that has been read to destruction.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone beaten up has been assaulted and badly hurt, physically battered.

clue.text: After little time, butcher has herd slaughtered

indicators.note: the jumbled part comes after the abbreviation for time

parts.note: T is the standard short form of time

indicators.note: to butcher something is to mangle it, so these words are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A butcher at work, killing a herd of cattle after a short wait.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Butcher' looks like the definition, but it is the anagram signal; 'slaughtered' is meant in its sporting sense.
explanation.definitionFit: A team that is slaughtered in a match has been heavily beaten, comprehensively defeated.

clue.text: Toast in dishes cut twice

indicators.note: cut means trimmed short, so the last letter of the dishes word is dropped
twice says the shortened word is written two times in a row

parts.note: china is crockery, plates and dishes

explanation.surface: A toast is made among dishes, offered twice over.
explanation.walkthrough: CHINA cut to CHIN, then written 'twice'.
explanation.definitionFit: Chin-chin is an old-fashioned informal toast, said when people raise glasses before drinking.

clue.text: Not just with brown or red hair, it seems?

definitions.text: with brown or red hair, it seems?
definitions.meaning: second meaning, playful: not fair-haired, so not blond

explanation.walkthrough: The second reading splits the word into a prefix meaning 'not' and fair meaning blond.
explanation.definitionFit: An unjust decision or arrangement is one that treats people inequitably.

clue.text: Wizard device guaranteeing security in conflict?

parts.note: war is armed conflict
a lock is a fastening that keeps a door secure

explanation.surface: A magical gadget that keeps you safe during war.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark admits the whimsy: a lock used in wartime.
explanation.definitionFit: A warlock is a male practitioner of witchcraft, a sorcerer.

clue.text: Fancy trousers say, something handed down

indicators.note: to trouser is to pocket, so the word for fancy takes the other letters inside

parts.note: lacy means ornate or fancy, like lacework
say introduces an example, abbreviated as for example

explanation.surface: Elaborate trousers passed on, for instance, as an heirloom.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Trousers' looks like a noun for clothing but is a verb meaning pockets.
explanation.definitionFit: A legacy is a bequest or inheritance passed from one generation to the next.

clue.text: Snobs are out for member of the nobility

indicators.note: out suggests the letters are disordered, put out of place

parts.note: taken as written, the letters to be rearranged

explanation.surface: Snooty types are excluded from an aristocrat's circle.
explanation.definitionFit: A baroness holds the lowest rank of the British peerage, a titled noblewoman.

clue.text: Strong in future, say

parts.note: taken as written
the future is an example of a grammatical tense

explanation.surface: A forecast that things will be powerful later on.
explanation.definitionFit: Intense feelings or heat are extreme, very strong in degree.

clue.text: Insect has noxious innards, to be honest

indicators.note: the insect has the other word within it
innards marks the word for noxious as forming the insect's insides

parts.note: a fly is a common winged insect
rank means foul-smelling, offensive

explanation.surface: A frank admission that a bug has foul guts.
explanation.definitionFit: Frankly is a sentence adverb meaning honestly or candidly speaking.

clue.text: Number eight unexceptional, to some extent

indicators.note: only part of the words is used, so the letters lie inside them

parts.note: the letters straddle the end of eight and the start of unexceptional

explanation.surface: A rating of eight out of ten is somewhat ordinary.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Number' reads as a figure like eight, but here it is a song or musical number.
explanation.definitionFit: A musical number is a song or piece performed, a tune.

clue.text: Ludicrous joke on corporation

indicators.note: in a down clue, on places the first word above the second

parts.note: a crack is a witty remark, a joke
corporation is old slang for a pot belly

explanation.surface: A silly gag made at the expense of a big company.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Corporation' looks like a company, but it is jocular slang for a paunch.
explanation.definitionFit: A crackpot idea is crazy or absurd, completely ridiculous.

clue.text: Top nail clean off

parts.note: a pin is a slender nail-like fastener

indicators.note: off implies the letters have gone wrong and are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written, the letters to be rearranged

explanation.surface: Instructions to get the top nail cleanly removed.
explanation.definitionFit: The pinnacle is the highest point or peak of something.

clue.text: Note, use of needles has inspired tattooists, primarily

indicators.note: to inspire is to breathe in, so the needlework word takes the letter inside it

parts.note: crochet is needlework done with a hooked needle

indicators.note: primarily picks the first letter of the word before it

parts.note: its first letter is used

explanation.surface: Needlework has given tattoo artists ideas, a remark worth noting.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Note' looks like an instruction to observe, but is the musical value.
explanation.definitionFit: A crotchet is a musical note of one beat, a quarter note in American usage.

clue.text: Destruction, one having broken ladder

indicators.note: the numeral breaks into the word for ladder, splitting it

parts.note: a ladder in tights is a run, a line of unravelled stitches

explanation.surface: Someone smashes a ladder and causes havoc.
explanation.walkthrough: A ladder in British usage is also a run in stockings.
explanation.definitionFit: Ruin is the state of decay or collapse that follows devastation.

clue.text: Copper coated in bright metal

indicators.note: the chemical symbol is wrapped in the word for bright

parts.note: merry means cheerful, bright in spirits

explanation.surface: Copper plated with a shiny metal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bright' suggests shine, but it means cheerful here.
explanation.definitionFit: Mercury is the silvery element that stays liquid at room temperature.

clue.text: Flood takes transport into river

indicators.note: the carrying word goes into the river's name

parts.note: the Dee is a river in Wales, England and Scotland
to lug is to carry something heavy

explanation.surface: A flood sweeps vehicles into a river.
explanation.definitionFit: A deluge is a severe inundation, as in Noah's great flood.

clue.text: Vessel in which mother keeps a gun, unloaded

indicators.note: the word for mother keeps the other letters within

parts.note: mum is an everyday word for mother
taken as written

indicators.note: unloaded empties the word, leaving only its outside letters

parts.note: only the outside letters remain once the middle is emptied out

explanation.surface: A mum hides an empty gun in a container.
explanation.walkthrough: Magnum is also a handgun, which lends the surface its picture.
explanation.definitionFit: A magnum is a wine bottle holding twice the standard capacity.

clue.text: Stunning device packed with energy in puzzle

indicators.note: the stun gun is filled with the energy symbol inside

parts.note: a Taser is an electric stun gun

explanation.surface: A high-powered stun gun appears in a riddle.
explanation.definitionFit: A teaser is a tricky problem or brainteaser.

clue.text: When swimming, notices a person on the water

indicators.note: letters that are swimming are moving around, so they are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written, the letters to be rearranged

explanation.surface: When you go swimming, you spot someone out on the lake.
explanation.definitionFit: A canoeist paddles a canoe, so spends time afloat on rivers and lakes.

clue.text: Attack from above, faster when flying

indicators.note: letters flying are scattered, so they are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written, the letters to be rearranged

explanation.surface: A warplane dives faster while flying in to attack.
explanation.definitionFit: To strafe is to attack ground targets with gunfire from low-flying aircraft.

clue.text: Rock 'n' roll

definitions.meaning: first meaning: to sway or stagger
second meaning: a spool, as of film or thread

explanation.walkthrough: Rock 'n' roll reads as music, which a reel also is as a Scottish dance.
explanation.definitionFit: A drunk reels when staggering, and a reel is also a cylinder that thread winds on.

clue.text: Improve vehicle

definitions.meaning: first meaning: to get better, recover
second meaning: a small open truck

explanation.walkthrough: The verb is written as two words, the vehicle hyphenated.
explanation.definitionFit: Business picks up when it recovers, and a pickup is a light truck with an open back.

clue.text: Spirit contains coloured liquid, I suppose

indicators.note: the spirit word holds the liquid word inside

parts.note: meths is methylated spirit
ink is a coloured fluid for writing

explanation.surface: Someone guesses that the spirit holds dye.
explanation.walkthrough: Meths is the British short form of methylated spirit.
explanation.definitionFit: Methinks is an archaic expression meaning it seems to me, I think.

clue.text: Almost unrivalled ancient city

indicators.note: almost means the phrase stops one letter short of its end

parts.note: unrivalled means peerless, the best of all

explanation.surface: An old city that was nearly without equal.
explanation.definitionFit: Thebes was a major city of Egypt and also of Greece in antiquity.

clue.text: Grandfather clock?

definitions.meaning: a clock is a device that keeps time, so the phrase can mean an elderly timepiece

explanation.walkthrough: Read as one phrase it is a long-case clock; split, it is an old man and an old timepiece.
explanation.definitionFit: A veteran or elderly person who has been around a long time is called this.
